title: Latest saved heat interface: exact outputs, field evidence and source navigation
summary: A focused continuation of the verified normal-workspace journey using actual completed CAD/solver outputs. No process decision or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open saved comparison
manualSteps.instruction: Open the latest saved heat working-interface link for the completed analysis run.

manualSteps.label: Inspect field
manualSteps.instruction: On revision_60_fine, click Open representation. Expand View numerical samples and select x_m, y_m and temperature_c.

manualSteps.label: Inspect assessment
manualSteps.instruction: Reopen the saved interface. On revision_60_fine, click Open assessment.

manualSteps.label: Inspect producer
manualSteps.instruction: Reopen the saved interface. On revision_60_fine, click Open producing step. Inspect the selected computation block.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reopen the saved comparison and reload. Leave all reviews unchanged.

steps.label: Latest comparison matches completed engineering outputs
steps.summary: The saved shared-controls interface reads all eighteen actual CAD/solver results.
steps.purpose: Prove current saved UI against completed outputs rather than only a waiting basis result.
steps.action: Open the latest saved heat comparison for the completed run.
steps.expected: Exact eighteen-result parity and original held assessment in a working context.
steps.actual: All eighteen identities match; exact working context and shared controls are present.

steps.label: Actual fine-field evidence and common parity
steps.summary: The latest interface opens all 765 supplied solver samples in the common evidence view.
steps.purpose: Prove shared exact navigation and actual numerical data.
steps.action: Open revision_60_fine, expand View numerical samples and select x_m, y_m, temperature_c.
steps.expected: Exact common result parity and all 765 real supplied samples.
steps.actual: Eighteen exact common results and all fine-grid samples rendered; no interpolation or engineering approval.

steps.label: Exact full heat assessment remains held
steps.summary: The interface opens the original assessment with twenty-five passes and one required-review hold.
steps.purpose: Retain engineering verification and exact result focus.
steps.action: Reopen the comparison and click Open assessment on revision_60_fine.
steps.expected: Original held assessment and exact fine-result focus.
steps.actual: Twenty-five passes, one blocked review and exact fine-result focus retained.

steps.label: Exact computation block selected
steps.summary: The comparison returns to its actual computation producer and inspector.
steps.purpose: Verify the shared navigation correction on a substantially different engineering process.
steps.action: Reopen the comparison and click Open producing step on revision_60_fine.
steps.expected: The exact accepted computation block selected.
steps.actual: Exact computation block and inspector selected; no stale-source warning.
